description:
List monitorable endpoints

Lists the HasData APIs a monitor can watch (most scraping APIs, e.g. SERP, Maps, Amazon, Zillow, Web Scraping). For each one returns the allowed resource params, required ones, enum options, defaults, typical credits per request, and the suggested and default tracked fields. Call this before createMonitor to pick the endpoint id, build valid resource params and choose fields.
name: hasdata_monitoring_monitors_listEndpoints
title: monitoring_monitors: GET /monitors/endpoints
